artworks.title: L'Art Celeste (The Celestial Art)
artworks.description: The image shows a composition of curved lines and smooth forms. On the left, a winged figure plays a violin-like instrument. To the right, a large face emerges with closed eyes. Below, curved lines suggest a surface or table.

artworks.title: La Peur (Fear)
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure on horseback traveling through a rugged, rocky landscape. The scene is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, showing mountains meeting the sky on the horizon. Clouds fill the sky above the rocky terrain. The artwork uses intricate etching with linear strokes to define textures and details. Sepia tones create an aged atmosphere. Cliffs and peaks are seen in the distance, with the horse and rider serving as a focal point in the foreground.

artworks.title: Jacob Haaringh (Young Haaringh) (Pieter Haaringh)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint and burin on japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated, focusing on his head and shoulders. He has a solemn expression, medium-length wavy hair, and wears a dark garment with a large collar. A window in the background provides soft lighting.

artworks.title: Le Scélérat Damiens
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a man in profile, with a focus on his head and upper torso. The man has a furrowed brow, deep-set eyes, a strong nose, curly hair, and is wearing a loose shirt. There are no visible accessories or objects in his hands. The background has abstract patterns and faint outlines in the upper right corner. The etching is monochromatic with shading emphasizing facial features and textures.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16.3 x 11.2 cm (6 7/16 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a religious scene involving an angel and a figure in a halo. The image features an angel to the left with large outstretched wings and detailed curly hair, holding a staff adorned with a banner. On the right, a figure is seated, draped in flowing garments, with a halo around their head, gazing downward. A potted plant with large leaves and flowers is in the foreground. Radiating rays of light descend from above, suggesting a divine presence. The setting includes a curtained area on the right and a textured floor pattern.

artworks.title: Bust of a Monk Assisting at Communion
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a drawing of a person from the shoulders up. The person is looking slightly to the right with closed or partially closed eyes. They have short, wavy hair and are wearing a textured garment wrapped around their shoulders and neck. The person is holding a large jug or vessel with intricate details in their right hand. The background is plain, emphasizing the figure and the vessel.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion with Four Angels
artworks.description: The image depicts a figure on a cross surrounded by two other figures, angels, and a landscape background.

artworks.title: Saint Catherine of Alexandria
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing upright, facing forward. They have delicate facial features, long wavy hair with a crown, and wear detailed, flowing garments. The person holds a sword in one hand, the blade pointing downwards towards a spiked wheel. The background is simple, with grass at the bottom for the figure's stance.

artworks.title: Saint John on Patmos
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 16 x 11.3 cm (6 5/16 x 4 7/16 in.)

artworks.title: Third Foolish Virgin
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing. Her body slightly turned to the side, with her left arm raised and hand touching her face, and her right arm holding a small bell. She has delicate facial features, long, flowing hair, and wears a flowing gown. At her feet, there is a circular shape. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.medium: pen and black and violet ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an image of an angelic figure appearing before a seated woman. The angel has wings and a flowing garment, descending from a cloud while holding a long rod or staff. The woman in classical attire is on a chair or throne, looking up at the angel with a sense of wonder. The setting includes intricate details such as drapery on a nearby table and decorative elements in the background. Two small, rabbit-like creatures are seen in the lower left corner. The line work is delicate with fine shading for depth and texture.

artworks.title: The Betrayal
artworks.medium: pen and black and violet ink with gray wash and graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of armed figures closely gathered in an intense and dynamic scene. The image depicts a chaotic assembly of armored individuals holding spears and other long weapons. The figures are intertwined, and the use of dark, moody tones with strong lines gives the scene a dramatic and intense atmosphere. The texture of the strokes and the compositional complexity suggest a sense of action and historical narrative. The artwork presents a sense of urgency and tension, with figures depicted in various dynamic poses amidst a swirling mass of energy and conflict.

artworks.title: Christ at the Column
artworks.medium: pen and black and violet ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 8.8 x 5.8 cm (3 7/16 x 2 5/16 in.)
support: 16.3 x 13 cm (6 7/16 x 5 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring several figures interacting around a central column. The composition includes muscular figures engaged with various objects in an intense moment of action. The setting includes columns and architectural details suggesting a classical or historical theme. The figures are rendered with line work and shading to give them volume and highlight their dynamic poses. A limited palette of purple and brown shades adds dramatic contrast to the scene. The intricate line work and detailed rendering of the figures suggest inspiration from Renaissance artists.

artworks.title: The Creation of Eve
artworks.medium: pen and black and violet ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a divine figure above animals. The divine figure is on clouds, gesturing downwards. Below, a nude figure is reaching upwards towards them. The environment surrounding them is filled with various animals, like a camel, lion, deer, and others.

artworks.title: The Last Judgment
artworks.medium: pen and black and violet ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of multiple nude figures in various poses. Some figures are seated while others seem to be ascending or interacting dynamically. At the top of the scene, there are winged figures among clouds. The use of shading and detailed lines gives depth to the figures and surroundings.

artworks.title: The Transfiguration
artworks.medium: pen and black and violet ink on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 8.7 x 5.7 cm (3 7/16 x 2 1/4 in.)
support: 16 x 12.7 cm (6 5/16 x 5 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a biblical scene. The drawing depicts a central figure, raised on a cloud, with arms outstretched and garments flowing. Surrounding this figure are other figures, some appearing to float nearby. The lower portion of the image shows a group of figures positioned on the ground gazing upward, with various postures that suggest reverence or awe. The drawing displays intricate linework, capturing a sense of dynamic movement and illustrating clouds, garments, and figures with detailed attention.

artworks.title: At the Moulin Rouge, la Goulue and Her Sister (Au Moulin Rouge, la Goulue et sa soeur))
The Milliner (La Modiste - Renée Vert)
artworks.description: The image depicts a silhouette of a person from the waist up in a mid-action pose. The person's facial features are obscured, with hair styled in an updo. The individual is wearing a long garment with a fitted waist. No jewelry or objects are visible. The background is a plain beige color.

artworks.title: The Milliner (La Modiste - Renée Vert)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman depicted from the back, with her entire form visible except for the far edge of her lower body. She is standing in front of a table with her arms raised, holding a large feathered hat. Her hair is styled up and she is wearing a long, fitted dress with puffed sleeves. On the table, two hats adorned with feathers are seen along with a hat box. The background is plain and monochrome.

artworks.title: The Milliner (La Modiste - Renée Vert)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a menu. It features a stylized depiction of a menu written in French, listing food items and beverages. A line drawing on the right shows a figure appearing to engage with a decorative element resembling a plant or floral arrangement. Below the menu, there is a round basket or hatbox. The background is minimalistic with fluid lines.

artworks.title: The Milliner (La Modiste - Renée Vert)
artworks.description: A woman placing a feathered hat on a display stand next to a printed but handwritten menu is printed shades of sage green on cream-colored paper in this vertical lithograph. The woman and menu are surrounded by a wide margin on all sides. The woman faces our left in profile. Her hair is pulled up and back. Her short jacket has sleeves puffed at the shoulders and tight along the arms. A skirt falls straight from her narrow waist. She stands on one side of a wide counter that holds two hat stands, and an oval-shaped hat box sits behind her feet. The woman’s body, features, clothing, and the objects around her are outlined with darker sage green. In the lower left corner, the menu reads as follows: “menu, Potages, St Germain Perles du Japon, Hors d’oeuvres, Radis Saucisson crevettes, Olives Buerre, Poisson, Fillets de Barbeu dieppoise legumes. Haricots verts maître d’hotel, petits pois bonne femme, Rots, Dindonneau au cresson, Salade, entremets Rocher de glace, Desserts assortis. Vins. Bordeaux. Champagne. Café. Cognac. On se mettra a table à 8 heures.” The bottom right corner of the printed image is stamped with a round, pale-green mark that combines the letters H, T, and L in a circle. A faint inscription in graphite in the lower left corner of the page is difficult to make out.

artworks.title: The Hairdresser - Program for the Théâtre Libre (Le coiffeur - Programme du Théâtre Libre)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black, yellow, and red
artworks.description: The image shows two people, a seated woman and another woman standing behind her. The seated woman is depicted from the side and slightly from behind, with long, flowing blonde hair and subtle facial features. She is holding an oval-shaped hand mirror in her right hand and wearing a loose-fitting garment. The standing woman has short hair pulled upward and is wearing a loose robe with vertical stripes. She is shown combing or styling the seated woman's hair. The background consists of a textured surface with vertical lines.

artworks.title: The Hairdresser - Program for the Theatre-Libre (Le coiffeur - Programme du Théatre-Libre)
artworks.medium: lithograph in green-black, yellow, and red
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in an upper-body portrayal. The person in the foreground is seated, holding a mirror in their left hand. They have long golden hair, red lips, and a serene expression. The person behind is combing the seated person's hair. It shows text in French related to theatre programs in the background.

artworks.title: Loge with the Gilt Mask (La loge au mascaron doré)
